title: How IQRA Works
subtitle: Whether you want to learn at your own pace or test your knowledge against time and friends, IQRA provides two tailored tracks to suit your learning style.

track1.title: Quizzes (Answer & Learn)
track1.subtitle: Untimed practice designed for thoughtful learning and discovering new knowledge.
track1.noTimer: Read explanations carefully without any rush. Become an Instant Quality Religious Authority (IQRA).
track1.leaderboard: Choose whether to submit your score or keep your practice private.

track2.title: Challenges (Play & Compete)
track2.subtitle: Timed quizzes to test your speed, unlock badges, and challenge peers.
track2.timer: Speed & accuracy combine for bonus points.
track2.posting: Post scores to global ranks or play strictly for fun.
